evidence.detail: Immediately after Client reads and ISAAC-decodes the inbound opcode into lO, it indexes rs/f/d.b[lO] and stores the result as the current inbound packet length lN.
Client treats table value -1 as one-byte variable length and -2 as two-byte variable length before waiting for/reading the packet body, exactly the inbound packet-framing contract.

The only exact-v308 external reference to rs/f/d is this Client inbound framing path; sibling array a is not consumed by stock v308, so the live class role is the incoming length lookup authority rather than a general packet registry.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the static incoming opcode-to-length framing table consumed by Client.
